account.note: FOUR LEVELS CHECKED, FOUR CLEAR, AND THIS IS THE FIRST HOUR TODAY WITH NO STORY IN IT. OKLO is 44.80 bid against a 45.1499 average, so the position is -0.77%, 0.70 of unrealized loss on a 90.30 cost, against a 54.18 target that needs the bid up 20.9% and a 41.54 stop that needs it down 7.3%. The time stop is the 8/14 close, today session one of five. No option is held, so no no-fly window can apply, and the calendar was re-pulled live rather than carried forward - 934 earnings events across 8/10 to 8/14, OKLO in none of them, SMCI on 8/11 pm verified at an 0.88 estimate still the only watched name inside the window. Nothing was hit, so nothing is proposed. THE BOARD MOVED AS ONE THING, AND THAT IS THE FINDING. Eleven of the twelve names are bid lower than at 13:22 - the broadest hour-over-hour decline of the session, against ten last hour, six at 12:22 and nine at 11:22 - and the single exception is UPST, higher by seven cents, which is not an exception so much as a rounding error. Breadth on the day is unchanged at 11 red of 12 with SMCI the only green name. There is no divergence to read this hour in either direction, because there is nothing for a name to diverge from when the whole list moves together. THAT IS THE CORRELATED-COMPLEX ARGUMENT ARRIVING AS MEASUREMENT RATHER THAN ASSERTION. The 2026-08-10 rule change caps this book at two names per complex on the reasoning that four names off this list is one position at four times the size, paying four spreads, with a stop all four gap through together. That was written as a forecast on Friday's inverted tape. This hour is the observation: twelve names, one direction, inside sixty minutes. The cap is not a preference about diversification, it is a description of what this universe does. AND THE THREE-HOUR RUN OF INVERTED TELLS ENDS BY PRODUCING NO TELL. The last three hours each read a character into the tape that the next hour contradicted - the 10:22 SOUN and UPST evidence, the 11:22 resumed-falling call, the 12:22 divergence. This hour offers nothing to invert: OKLO rejoined the decline it briefly stepped out of, four cents lower, and is neither leading nor lagging. An hour that yields no narrative is the correct output for a slot whose job is levels, and it is recorded with the same weight as the hours that yielded one. WHAT IS NEW AND DURABLE IS THE POSITION'S SIZE, WHICH IS THE OTHER HALF OF THE 8/10 RULE AND HAS NOT BEEN WRITTEN DOWN UNTIL NOW. At 89.60 the position is 8.88% of the 1009.20 account, BELOW the ~10% floor at which that rule says a position gets a warning rather than a block. Two shares carried to a full +20% take-profit adds about 18.06 to a 1009.20 account - 1.8% of the day, against a stated objective of about 10% a day - while consuming the same attention, the same spread and the same five sessions as a position that could move it. Every prior read framed this holding against the 40% single-name ceiling and cleared it easily; the binding number at the other end is the one it is actually near. This is an observation about the position, not a reason to add to it: averaging into a name mid-decline is on the rulebook's does-not-fit list by name. Deployable is 919.58 settled with nothing pending. NO NEW ORDER IN THE ACCOUNT SINCE THE 10:39 FILL, queried directly rather than inferred: one order exists in this account since 8/7, the OKLO buy filled 10:39:30 ET at 45.1499 on a 45.40 limit, placed_agent agentic, with no specification from any run here behind it. The escalation is carried a fifth hour unchanged and uncompounded. Against the 2026-08-10 concentration rule the book is one name of four and one of the two the nuclear complex allows.
account.priorNote: FOUR LEVELS CHECKED, FOUR CLEAR, AND THE STOP MOVED FURTHER AWAY RATHER THAN CLOSER. Nothing was hit, so nothing is proposed. THE LAST HOUR'S WARNING DID NOT MATERIALISE, AND THAT IS RECORDED WITH THE SAME PROMINENCE IT WAS ISSUED. The 12:22 run wrote down that the 41.54 stop had closed to 6.2% on a name that had already travelled 8.57% that day, and that an ordinary continuation of the session reaches it. The session did not continue that way: the bid rose 0.57 to 44.84 and the stop is 7.4% away, wider than an hour ago and wider than at 11:22. The warning was worth writing and it was worth not acting on, which are two separate findings and this run owes both. Selling at -1.95% because -8% looked reachable would have been the error the note explicitly refused to make, and an hour later the distance had gone the other way. THE FINDING IS THAT LAST HOUR'S DIVERGENCE INVERTED. The 12:22 read was that the board had stopped falling while the position had not - breadth 9 red of 12, six names up and six down, OKLO alone at a new low - and it drew from that a name-specific problem, a name that had declined to participate in two of its own complex's bounces. Both halves reversed inside the hour. Breadth is 11 RED of 12, the worst read of the day, with SMCI the only green name; ten of the twelve names are bid lower than at 12:22; and OKLO is one of only two that are higher. The name that was singled out for falling alone is now rising nearly alone. THIS IS THE THIRD TELL TO INVERT INSIDE AN HOUR TODAY and the pattern is now the finding rather than any one of them: 10:22 offered SOUN and UPST as evidence and both inverted by 11:22; 11:22's own bounce read was given back; 12:22's divergence is reversed here. Three hours of intraday character-reading on a twelve-name board have produced three reversals, which is the argument for a slot that enforces levels and does not trade its own narrative. Deployable is 919.58 settled with nothing pending. NO NEW ORDER IN THE ACCOUNT SINCE THE 10:39 FILL, queried directly rather than inferred: one order exists in this account since 8/7, the OKLO buy filled 10:39:30 ET at 45.1499 on a 45.40 limit, placed_agent agentic, with no specification from any run here behind it. The escalation is carried a fourth hour unchanged and uncompounded. Against the 2026-08-10 concentration rule the book is one name of four, 8.9% of account value at the bid against a 40% single-name ceiling, and one of the two the nuclear complex allows.
account.operatorNote: OPERATOR, 2026-08-10, answering the funding escalation carried in the notes above rather than editing either of them. The 900.00 is a deposit I made; the account is funded to about 1000 and the cash is spendable. This answers the deposit and NOTHING ELSE - it is not an authorisation for the OKLO order the 10:46 sync found, which no run here published and which arrived through the same agentic channel escalated on 8/7; that escalation stands open and unanswered. Three rule changes go with it and all three are written up in docs/RULES.md with their arithmetic, because a licence recorded without its constraints is how this record stops being worth reading. The position ceiling goes from two to four, capped at 40% in any one name and at two names in any one complex - the complex cap is the one that matters on a board whose whole universe moves together. Overnight holds are not a change: they were always allowed, the five-session time stop stands, and it is not extendable by conviction. The objective is still about 10% a day, which is roughly 101 dollars at this size and needs a fully deployed four-name book to average +10% in a session against a +20% take-profit; where the objective and the rulebook conflict, the rulebook wins and the retro records the shortfall. What the deposit does NOT do is reopen options - that refusal has been on spread for three sessions, most recently 36% of mark against a 10% ceiling, and no balance narrows a spread. The 10:22 hourly was right to escalate this rather than size against it.
account.openingNote: THIS IS THE OPENING READ AND THE DAILY ENTRY MANDATE IS DISCHARGED, forced on item 1: buy 12 JOBY at a 8.85 limit, target 10.62, stop 8.14, time stop the 8/14 close, expiring 10:30 ET. Exits were checked before entries and there was nothing to check - a flat book means no target, no stop, no time stop and no option expiry no-fly window was due, and none went unenforced. Two things this run settled that were handed to it by name. FIRST, the straddle Friday's pre-close owed to this slot was pulled: the SMCI 8/14 32 call marks 2.51 against a 2.05 put, a 4.56 straddle on a 32.21 spot, so the market prices a 14.2% move on tomorrow night's print. SMCI is refused on that arithmetic and not on a view - the rulebook stops equity at -8%, and an 8% stop sits entirely inside a 14.2% expected move, so the realistic bad case gaps through the stop rather than filling at it and the exit written before entry would not be the exit taken. That matters beyond the refusal, because SMCI was the ONLY name on this board with a forward catalyst, and once it is gone item 1 cannot be passed anywhere on the list. SECOND, options were priced before any thesis was built, as the 8/5 rule requires, and are refused for a third consecutive session on SPREAD rather than affordability: eight contracts quoted live across JOBY, SOUN and SMR at 3-6 weeks, every one clearing the 0.40 delta floor, several affordable outright, and the tightest of them at 36% of mark against a 10% ceiling. Three different cash balances - 128.90, 126.06 and now 109.88 - have produced the same answer, which is the point at which it stops being about the balance. The tape reversed wholesale over the weekend: breadth is 10 RED of 12 after six consecutive 10-green reads on Friday, and the names that extended hardest into Friday's bell are the ones being unwound hardest now. JOBY is one of two green names and the only green one without a print tomorrow. That is the entry, and it is also exactly what is wrong with it - relative strength on a red tape is a real condition and it is not a catalyst, so item 1 is marked fail and the entry is published forced rather than dressed up as something cleaner.

positions.note: EVERY LEVEL CHECKED AGAINST THE 14:22 BID AND EVERY LEVEL CLEAR, which remains the only claim this slot is entitled to make. THE NAME STOPPED BEING THE STORY. Four cents lower than an hour ago, inside a board where eleven of twelve names fell, it is neither leading the decline nor sitting out of it - the first hour today in which this position has nothing distinguishing to say about itself. That retires the divergence question in both of the directions it was argued this session: at 12:22 the name fell while the board firmed and was read as a name-specific problem; at 13:22 the name rose while the board fell and the reading was retracted; this hour there is no gap between them to interpret. It is still the worst name on the list on the day at -7.48% for a sixth consecutive read, and SOUN at -7.23% is now within a quarter of a point of it. THE SIZE IS THE NUMBER WORTH ADDING, AND IT IS THE FLOOR RATHER THAN THE CEILING. At 89.60 this is 8.88% of a 1009.20 account, under the ~10% threshold at which the 8/10 rule warns that a position is too small to matter: carried to the full +20% target it adds about 18.06, which is 1.8% of the account against a stated objective near 10% a day, and it costs the same spread, the same stop discipline and the same five sessions as a position that could move the day. Five prior reads measured this holding against the 40% single-name ceiling and cleared it by a wide margin; the limit it is actually close to is at the other end. Recorded as a fact about the book, not as an argument to add - adding to a name that is the worst performer on its own board is averaging down, which the rulebook lists by name as a setup that does not fit. Everything already said about the entry stands: this is the name the 10:22 candidate row refused under item 2 as day one of a decline, and the fill sits within a nickel of the bid at which it was refused. Provenance is unchanged and unresolved - one order in this account since 8/7, tagged to the agentic channel, no specification from any run here behind it, and nothing new in the three hours and forty-three minutes since. That is the retro's to answer; this slot's job is to enforce the levels on a position that exists, whoever opened it, and the levels are clear. Tagged nuclear, which puts SMR and LEU on the same two-name limit as this position.

entryWatch.setup: JOBY post-earnings continuation - EXPIRED UNEXECUTED, and the fifth re-mark extends an unbroken sequence
entryWatch.trigger: None, and the trigger stays dead in both directions. The 8.85 limit expired at 10:30 ET; JOBY is 8.55 bid, thirty cents BELOW the level, and re-striking a dead specification is a mid-session entry this slot refuses whether the name is above the limit or under it.
entryWatch.why: FIVE RE-MARKS, MONOTONE IN ONE DIRECTION, AND NOT ONE OF THEM IS A RULE. At 10:22 this board recorded that the forced 8.85 entry would be showing a gain, JOBY being 9.05 bid and 2.3% past the limit. Then -0.79% at 11:22, -2.03% at 12:22, -2.49% at 13:22, and -3.39% at the 8.55 bid now. Every one of those statements was true when written and the sequence has not reversed once in four hours; it is tracked at all because the forced arm is measured separately rather than blended into an average that would hide it. What the sequence demonstrates is the ground the 10:22 refusal actually rested on: a name that runs 2.3% past its level in forty minutes can come back through it and keep going for four more hours, so chasing it upward would have been the error rather than the missed opportunity it looked like at the time. JOBY has now given back the whole of the +4.7% it carried at 10:22 and is -1.04% on the day.

entryWatch.why: Unchanged in arithmetic and softer again in tape - 31.73 bid, +1.93%, against +2.25% an hour ago, +3.5% at 12:22 and +5.7% at 10:22, so the give-back has now run four consecutive hours. None of that touches the refusal, which was never about direction. The 8/14 32 call marked 2.51 against a 2.05 put for a 4.56 straddle on a 32.21 spot: a 14.2% implied move against a rulebook stop of 8%. An 8% stop sitting entirely inside a 14.2% expected move is an exit the event is priced to jump rather than fill, which is the sense in which item 3 is a gate and not a formality. Any 3-6 week option necessarily spans the print and is forbidden outright, so the option route was never reachable either. The print is now about twenty-six hours out and this board holds nothing in it. It remains the only green name on a board of twelve, which is exactly the shape of tape in which a pre-earnings bid looks like strength; it was refused at 09:41 on a number, and a number does not stop being the reason because the name held up for a session.
